blocks.text: Employees may book economy travel for journeys under six hours. Longer journeys may be booked in premium economy with manager approval.

runs.text: Employees may book economy travel for journeys under six hours. Longer journeys may be booked in premium economy with manager approval.

blocks.text: Accommodation is reimbursed at the published rate for the destination.

runs.text: Accommodation is reimbursed at the published rate for the destination.

notes.text: Journey time is measured from scheduled departure to scheduled arrival.
Approval must be recorded before booking.
Rates are reviewed each January and published on the intranet.
